outputs.title: How to set up onboarding rules and public signups in BFFless
outputs.summary: In this video I show how to configure onboarding rules in BFFless so that new users automatically get repository access when they create an account. I walk through the site settings to create a rule that grants view access on user sign up, then enable public signups so anyone can register. I also demonstrate the full flow by creating a test user and confirming they can browse the repository and explore everything BFFless has to offer on the backend.
